preconditions.description: The number of files n is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 and name.islower() for name in file_names)
preconditions.description: Each file name is a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.
The number of file names matches the given number n.

preconditions.expression: all(section[0] in file_names for section in sections)
preconditions.description: Each section starts with a file name listed in the second line of input.

preconditions.expression: all(len(section) == section[1] + 1 for section in sections)
preconditions.description: Each section has the correct number of lines based on the given k value.

preconditions.expression: all(all(dep in file_names for dep in section[2:]) for section in sections)
preconditions.description: Each dependency in the import statements is a file name listed in the second line of input.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SHIP IT' or (len(stdout.split()) >= 3 and all(name in file_names for name in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'SHIP IT' or a list of file names forming a cycle.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SHIP IT' or all(stdout.split()[i] in sections[file_names.index(stdout.split()[i-1])][2:] for i in range(len(stdout.split())))
postconditions.description: If there is a cycle, each file in the output imports the next file in the list, and the last file imports the first.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SHIP IT' or len(stdout.split()) == min(len(cycle.split()) for cycle in all_cycles)
postconditions.description: If there is a cycle, the output is a shortest cycle.
